label: Whatever is BLESSED_2 is BLESSED_1
paraphrase: Open sense bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed. Whatever has intellect, is universally perfect, is good as to being and is IN_ACT_3 in understanding (BLESSED_2) has, in and from itself, the perfect good of an intellectual nature (BLESSED_1, the primitive Primitives.MostBlessed). After ST I q.26 a.1-2. It carries what BLESSED_2 leaves untyped: ex se, knowing one's own sufficiency in the good possessed, and formal rather than merely virtual understanding. BLESSED_1 is read the Thomist way (beatitude formally in the intellect, q.26 a.2); a Scotist reading (beatitude formally in the will's enjoyment) would be a further sense, which this bridge does not reach. Strictly weaker than 'Whatever is PERFECT_2 and HAS_INTELLECT_1 is BLESSED_1' (its antecedent adds goodness and act in understanding; Control part 3: a perfect intellectual being not in act in understanding satisfies this bridge vacuously and falsifies the old one).
